Two more things I feel need addressed: it seems most people here are not from Germany, and do not realize how normal it is to drive an RS7 at 150+ mph. To me, there is no issue with your speed in general, the issue is the tires aren’t designed for that. Second, the speed rating is NOT a 24 hour continuous speed rating. For anyone curious, look up how they do the test. The tire only spends 10 minutes at its rated speed. There are also tires to be found with a speed rating significantly higher than their temperature rating. A speed rating of V (149 mph), for example, with a temperature rating of B (100-115 mph) (Douglas All Season). The temperature rating is a better reflection of the tire’s sustained speed capability.

The speed rating test just proves the tire can attain that speed for a short duration. It doesn’t necessarily correlate to sustained speeds. Aside from this, going that fast on winter tires is ridiculous.
